LanguageData.SetUpCampNote: Note: these values are not retroactive and will not effect existing camps
LanguageData.CampResourcesTooltip: Allow camp maps to generate non-rock resources.
LanguageData.RaidTimerTooltip: Roughly the number of days before a campsite will be raided.\nEnter 0 to disable.
LanguageData.AbandonedCampDurationTooltip: The number of days abandoned campsites will persist on the world map.\nEnter 0 to disable.
LanguageData.PersistCampTooltip: Allows permanent camps that can exists without colonists present.
LanguageData.PersistCampWarn: Warning: Unmarking a persistent camp while a colonist is not present will cause it to be abandoned.
LanguageData.PersistCampDefaultTooltip: Newly created camps will be automatically marked as persistent if enabled.
LanguageData.ConfirmEmptyCampsTooltip: Removes the confirmation dialog when unmarking persistent camps if disabled.
